none: PAS NLM-2FD4E1: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Valentinian (364-378), Victory left issue, possibly Arles mint, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Youthful bust diademed cuirassed right; large eye. Obverse inscription: possibly DN VA[----]. Reverse description: Victory advancing left with wreath and palm; OF II in field. Reverse inscription: [SECVRITAS] REI PVBLICAE. Diameter: 16mm, Weight: 1.72gms, Die axis: 12
